1. Parties
This synthetic agreement is between Atlas Buyer and Beacon Supplier.
2. Services
Supplier shall deliver the test report upon receipt of the order, subject to approved scope.
3. Payment
Buyer shall pay the invoiced amount within 30 days of invoice, provided the invoice is valid.
4. Liability
Liability is limited to the fees paid for the test service.
5. Termination
Buyer may terminate this agreement if Supplier fails to cure within 20 days of notice.
6. Governing Law
This agreement is governed by the laws of Fictional Territory.
